title: Alle Corona Persconferenties geannoteerd met Searle's Speech Acts
descriptions: A spreadsheet with all Dutch press conferences regarding the Corona/Covid 19 virus from the period March 6th 2020 and April 20th 2021. The conferences are split into sentences, with rich metadata added. Among these * Searle's speech acts per sentence (hand annotated 10K sentences) * 5 techniques for changing behaviour (hand annotated 23K sentences) * speaker per sentence * several automatic NLP data (lemmas, POS, chunks)
